analysis_type: Independent arithmetic and static source audit of existing sensitivity outputs; no model inference or parameter changes

statistics.estimand: case-macro mean and paired variant-minus-release difference
statistics.interval: pointwise descriptive percentile 95%; no multiplicity correction
statistics.case_order: lexicographic case_id, matching original analysis CSV sort

parameter_semantics.detail_bonus: Add 0.08 only for detail classes where original direct spatial support >0.38, after parent/residual/child-floor and eligible-host suppression. This does not disable the direct-detail gate when set to zero.
parameter_semantics.conflict_penalty: Penalty 0.72 means retained host-evidence multiplier 0.28 on eligible overlap union. It is distinct from scene_layer_fallback_weight=0.72 in candidate weighting.
parameter_semantics.conflict_zero: conflict_penalty=0 only sets host suppression multiplier to1; child-floor ratio0.90 and its eligibility logic remain active. Disabling specificity ownership removes both child-floor update and host suppression.
parameter_semantics.parent_factor: For nonroot classes with existing hard parent support, multiply evidence by1 inside dilated support and orphan_support**hierarchy_strength outside; default0.12**0.65=0.2520390360441707. Parent attenuation precedes residual and child-floor updates.
parameter_semantics.orphan_dual_use: orphan_support is also the minimum dilated parent support in the direct-detail gate. Its intervention is not an isolated exponent-factor ablation.
parameter_semantics.equation3: S_k(x)=[1-0.72 o_k(x)] E_k(x)+0.08 d_k(x), where E already includes parent attenuation, parent-residual and child-floor updates; bonus is not multiplied by those earlier factors.

source_anchors.analyze_revision.py: variants(); case_worker(); run_sensitivity(); bootstrap(); published portable copy retained in source hashes

claim_limits: Post-review diagnostic reuse of226 cases and archived accepted candidates, not independent validation of development overfitting.
Local stable aggregate F1 does not prove optimal constants, statistical equivalence, or stable pixel/identity maps.
Accepted-pool replay does not rerun upstream proposal generation or the original serial Group gates and does not establish full-pipeline robustness.
detail_bonus=.12 gives higher observed geometric F1 than release; retain this evidence and do not call the release optimum.
Original intervals are case-bootstrap intervals, not the60-category bootstrap used by other diagnostics.
